entities.name: George T. Conway III
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: George Thomas Conway III is an American lawyer and activist. Conway argued and won the 2010 case Morrison v. National Australia Bank before the Supreme Court of the United States. He was married to the campaign manager of Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign.
